title: Add Mark Past Attendance flow + missed-day handling + daily reminder notification

requirements.text: Add a new Dashboard quick-action button labeled exactly "Mark Past Attendance" placed below the existing "Mark Today's Classes" button, and wire it to open a dedicated past-attendance marking flow without rebuilding or removing existing flows.

quotes:
Add a separate button on dashboard:
"Mark Past Attendance"
Place it below the normal “Mark Today’s Attendance” button.

acceptanceCriteria: Dashboard shows a distinct button labeled exactly "Mark Past Attendance" directly below the "Mark Today's Classes" button.
Clicking "Mark Past Attendance" opens the past-attendance flow UI.
Existing "Mark Today's Classes" flow continues to work unchanged.

requirements.text: Implement a calendar-based past-date selector for the "Mark Past Attendance" flow that allows selecting any previous date and prevents selecting future dates with clear English feedback.

quotes:
Open a calendar view
User can select any previous date
Do NOT allow selecting future dates
Prevent marking future dates

acceptanceCriteria: The past-attendance flow displays a calendar UI for picking a date.
Future dates cannot be selected; attempting to select a future date is blocked and shows a clear English message (for example: "You cannot mark attendance for a future date.").
Selecting a valid past date proceeds to the subject list for that date.

requirements.text: For a selected past date, compute and display the scheduled subjects for that day using both (a) the weekly repeating timetable based on the date’s weekday and (b) any per-date overrides already supported by the app (for example, class exchanges tied to a specific date).

quotes: Both

acceptanceCriteria: Given a selected date, the subject list is derived from the weekday timetable slots for that weekday.
If a class exchange exists for the selected date, the displayed subjects reflect the exchange for that date.
If no subjects are scheduled for the selected date, the UI shows a clear English empty state (for example: "No classes scheduled for this date.").

requirements.text: Allow the user to mark each scheduled subject for the selected past date as Present or Absent and save the attendance with the selected date, recording per-subject status plus a timestamp.

quotes:
Allow user to mark:
Present
Absent
Save attendance with selected date.

Store attendance with:
userId
date
subject
status
timestamp

acceptanceCriteria: The subject list for the selected date provides Present and Absent choices for each subject.
Saving creates persisted records that include: date (YYYY-MM-DD), subject identifier, status, and timestamp.
After saving, the UI returns to a sensible state (for example: closes the past-attendance flow) and the saved attendance is reflected in the app’s attendance stats derived from events.
All user-facing labels and messages in this flow are English.

requirements.text: Enforce duplicate-marking prevention for past attendance: a user must not be able to mark the same date twice; if the date has already been marked, block saving and show the exact English message: "Attendance already marked for this date".

quotes:
User cannot mark same date twice
If already marked → show message: "Attendance already marked for this date"
Prevent duplicate marking
Validate on backend

acceptanceCriteria: If attendance has already been saved for a date, the UI indicates it cannot be marked again and shows exactly: "Attendance already marked for this date".
Frontend blocks the save action for an already-marked date even before calling the backend (best-effort).

Backend rejects any attempt to save attendance for a date that already has a saved day record for that caller and returns an error that the frontend maps to exactly: "Attendance already marked for this date".
No duplicate per-date records are created in backend state.

requirements.text: Add backend (Motoko) support for storing per-caller per-date attendance-day records (including date, per-subject status, and timestamp) and validating both "no future dates" and "no duplicate date" rules on save.

quotes: Validate on backend
Prevent marking future dates
Prevent duplicate marking
Save all changes in database

Store attendance with:
userId
date
subject
status
timestamp

acceptanceCriteria: Backend exposes a shared method for the authenticated caller to save a past-attendance day record for a given date.
Backend storage keys attendance records by (caller principal, date).
Backend rejects future dates for saves.
Backend rejects duplicate saves for the same date for the same caller.
Backend stores timestamp for the save and per-subject statuses for that date.

requirements.text: Integrate the past-attendance save into the frontend data model by creating corresponding ClassEvent entries (or an equivalent existing local event model) for the selected date so that existing calculations and UI (overall %, subject cards, subject details) reflect the saved past attendance without introducing new attendance-calculation logic.

quotes: Save attendance with selected date.
Do not affect streak logic incorrectly

If user marks past attendance:
Recalculate streak properly
Update points correctly

acceptanceCriteria: Saving past attendance results in local state updates that reuse existing event-driven calculations (no new percentage/stats logic).
Past-dated attendance is included in overall and per-subject stats where appropriate.
No existing attendance calculation functions are replaced; changes are limited to adding valid events and reusing existing computation paths.

requirements.text: Ensure streak and milestone points are recalculated correctly when past attendance is added: the existing continuous-day streak computation must reflect the newly added past date events, and milestone point awards must not be double-awarded for milestones that were already recorded as awarded.

quotes:
Do not affect streak logic incorrectly
If user marks past attendance:
Recalculate streak properly
Update points correctly

acceptanceCriteria: After saving past attendance that changes the set of completed days, the displayed streak value updates to the correct current streak based on existing rules.
If adding past attendance causes a streak to reach a milestone that has not yet been awarded, the app awards the correct points once.
If the milestone was already awarded (per existing milestone award state), the app does not award it again.

requirements.text: Remove or disable any existing "auto-mark absent" or automatic missed-attendance penalty behavior so that if the user forgets to mark attendance, the system does nothing automatically and leaves the day unmodified.

quotes: Do NOT auto-mark absent.

If user forgets to mark attendance:
Do nothing automatically
No automatic penalty unless admin defines rule.

acceptanceCriteria: No code path automatically creates "missed" ClassEvent entries for a day solely because it was not marked.
If the user does not mark attendance for a day, the app does not change attendance totals automatically.
User can later fill the missed day using the "Mark Past Attendance" flow.

requirements.text: Implement a once-per-day attendance reminder notification check: if the user has not marked today’s attendance by a fixed local time (default 7:00 PM), send a browser notification with Title exactly "Attendance Not Marked 📢" and Body exactly "You haven’t marked today’s attendance. Tap to update now.", respecting notification settings and sending at most once per calendar day.

quotes:
If user has not marked attendance by a fixed time (example: 7 PM):
Send push notification:
Title: "Attendance Not Marked 📢"
Body: "You haven’t marked today’s attendance. Tap to update now."
Notification Rules
Send only once per day
Respect user notification settings

Works for both:
App users
Web users

acceptanceCriteria: If today has no attendance marked (no ClassEvent for today) at/after 7:00 PM local time, the app attempts to send the reminder notification.
The reminder notification Title is exactly "Attendance Not Marked 📢".
The reminder notification Body is exactly "You haven’t marked today’s attendance. Tap to update now.".
The reminder is only sent once per calendar day (local date) even if the app remains open or the user navigates around.
If notifications are disabled in settings or permission is not granted, no reminder is sent.

requirements.text: When the user clicks the reminder notification (while the app is running), bring the app window into focus and open the attendance marking UI (the existing "Mark Today's Classes" sheet) so the user can update attendance immediately.

quotes: Clicking notification should open attendance screen

acceptanceCriteria: Clicking the reminder notification focuses the app window/tab.
Clicking the reminder notification opens the existing attendance marking UI for today (the Mark Today sheet) without requiring additional manual navigation.
If the app cannot open the sheet for any reason, the user is navigated to the Dashboard and shown a clear English message explaining what to do next.

requirements.text: Persist the reminder-deduping state (for example, the last local date a reminder was sent) through the existing IndexedDB persistence and backup/restore flows in a backward-compatible way (merging missing fields with defaults).

quotes: Send only once per day
Save all changes in database

acceptanceCriteria: A new persisted field is added to support reminder deduping across refreshes.
Existing users with older stored state can load the app without errors; missing reminder fields default safely.
Exported backups include the reminder-deduping field, and restoring a backup restores that field.
Older backups without the field still restore correctly with defaults.

requirements.text: Add clear English user-facing messaging in the past-attendance flow and reminder flow for all major error states (future date blocked, duplicate date, no subjects scheduled, notifications disabled/unsupported/permission denied), reusing existing toast/alert patterns.

quotes: Attendance already marked for this date
Prevent marking future dates
Respect user notification settings

acceptanceCriteria: All user-facing messages added by this upgrade are English.
Duplicate-day error displays exactly "Attendance already marked for this date".
Future-date attempts show a clear English message.
If notifications cannot be sent due to unsupported browser/permission/settings, the app provides clear English feedback in UI where relevant (and does not silently fail).

constraints: Do not rebuild the app; upgrade the existing codebase only.

Frontend immutable paths must not be edited: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
Backend must remain a single Motoko actor with all logic in backend/main.mo; add backend/migration.mo only if existing stable state must be upgraded.
All new user-facing text introduced by this change must be English, except where the user specified an exact string to display.
No Firebase/FCM or true background push notifications; implement reminder using the existing browser Notifications API capabilities in this web app context.
nonGoals: Implementing true background push notifications when the app/browser is closed (not supported on this platform).
Introducing an admin rule engine for automatic penalties (explicitly deferred by the user).
Changing existing attendance calculation algorithms beyond feeding them correct past-dated events.
Adding new timetable paradigms beyond using the existing weekly timetable plus existing per-date overrides (such as exchanges).
